description: Maternity benefits / декретные пособия / декрет төлемдері. Estimates the Kazakhstan state benefits around a birth in 2026: the one-off birth payment, the maternity leave payment (126 days, or 140 days for a complicated or multiple birth), and the monthly childcare allowance until the child is 1.5 years old. For an employed mother it needs two incomes: the average monthly insured income for the last 12 months (leave) and for the last 24 months (childcare). For a mother who is not employed, only the fixed amounts by child rank apply and incomes are ignored.

average_monthly_income_12m_kzt.description: Average monthly insured income for the last 12 months (maternity leave base), in tenge (KZT) per month. Required when is_employed is true.

average_monthly_income_24m_kzt.description: Average monthly insured income for the last 24 months (childcare allowance base), in tenge (KZT) per month. Required when is_employed is true.

child_rank.description: Birth order of this child: 1, 2, 3, or 4 for the fourth and any later child.

is_employed.description: True if the mother has insured employment income; false for a mother who is not employed.

lang.description: Language of source titles, limitation notes and page links: "ru" (Russian) or "kk" (Kazakh). Default "ru".

leave_type.description: "standard" (126 days, single birth) or "complicated" (140 days: complicated or multiple birth).

name: kz_maternity_benefits
title: Kazakhstan maternity and childcare benefits (2026)
